nonShareableNotes: IOS-054 dead-session filtering, IOS-055 0.01-second timeout, and IOS-056 ready-file race each require their own state transition/timing evidence.
IOS-062 and each IOS-063 level require distinct predicate/level invocations; compare line counts only within matched fixtures.
IOS-066 trailing and IOS-067 full snapshot modes require their exact modes; never derive one from another.
IOS-068 crash-flow continuation and IOS-134 failing-screen continuation are separate because their failure origins and remaining-work clauses differ.
IOS-073 flow timeout and IOS-135 screen wait timeout remain distinct timed invocations.
IOS-078 requires all three exact matcher forms as separate invocations.
IOS-152 requires plain, quiet, verbose, and quiet-negative outputs with byte comparisons; no ordinary run substitutes.
IOS-079 must use the default recording destination; IOS-080 must independently prove the spaced explicit output path.
executionRules: No live, device, WDA, compiler, or build command until root activates an exclusive iOS reservation.
Preserve command/env/cwd/timestamps/exits and raw streams for every invocation even when a shared fixture supports multiple keys.
A shared capture is accepted only when command, flags, inputs, runtime, artifact, target, and precondition satisfy every joined clause; otherwise split it before grading.
Primary devices are shutdown-only during scoped recovery and never deleted. Authenticate every extra UUID before mutation; at most two extras coexist.
Use both GRANTIVA_RUNNER_HOME and MAESTRO_RUNNER_HOME with the bound iOS home, GRANTIVA_SESSION_ID=candidate5-ios, and GRANTIVA_API_KEY unset.
Restore frozen app after any scratch install; preserve protected inventories; finish with primaries Booted/frozen, extras retired, and no owned workers/sessions/forwards.
